purpose: Define the exact runtime, role, payload, and q-module behavior so implementation can be completed deterministically without guessing.
core_problem_being_solved: q/runtime/role logic has mixed together backend params, UI params, role materialization, and instance overrides. The target architecture is: canonical reusable roles + direct q-root resolution + base payload overlay model + strict separation of backend params vs UI params.
final_goal: Every q-capable instance resolves its effective request strictly from active instance/module state plus canonical role data, builds one final payload, and sends it to the backend. No duplicated role materialization. No wrong root fallback. No UI-only fields leaking into backend payload logic.

locked_rules.R001: Roles are canonical reusable templates. They are not one-time loaded instance copies.
locked_rules.R002: #ROLES is the canonical source of reusable role data.
locked_rules.R003: A q instance stores only runtime data, explicit instance overrides, and the selected role reference.
locked_rules.R004: Effective request config is built at execution time, not pre-materialized into instance state.
locked_rules.R005: Payload merge order is: base alias/profile payload -> role overlay -> instance override overlay.
locked_rules.R006: Precedence is: instance override > role > alias/profile base.
locked_rules.R007: q module runtime path format is always |<instance>:<module_id>:<field>.
locked_rules.R008: Instance-level generic layout fields remain under |<instance>:<field>.
locked_rules.R009: STORAGE_PREFIX-based q storage logic must not exist anywhere in the active implementation.
locked_rules.R010: Backend param name is think, not thinking.
locked_rules.R011: UI/render param name is show_thinking. It is not a backend param.
locked_rules.R012: stream is a backend param and must travel through the same effective-config pipeline as other backend params.
locked_rules.R013: show_thinking is UI-only and must never affect backend payload generation.
locked_rules.R014: If a backend-relevant field exists in role data, it must reach the final effective payload unless explicitly overridden by the instance.
locked_rules.R015: think supports backend-native types. It is not globally forced to boolean.
locked_rules.R016: Ollama uses think as boolean true/false.
locked_rules.R017: GPT-OSS/OpenAI-style reasoning uses think mapped to backend-native reasoning effort such as low/medium/high.
locked_rules.R018: The active q root must be resolved directly from the currently active q module root, e.g. |Q:q or |HELP:q.
locked_rules.R019: q param resolution must read from the active q root directly. It must not depend on incorrect fallback roots.
locked_rules.R020: :ch must contain response/content only. Thinking text must never be appended into :ch.
locked_rules.R021: If show_thinking is on and the backend produces visible thinking, show thinking live until response begins.
locked_rules.R022: When response begins, visible response replaces visible thinking in the live display area.
locked_rules.R023: When the run finishes, the live view returns to :ch-backed history.
locked_rules.R024: If show_thinking is off, thinking is not rendered at all.
locked_rules.R025: If think is off for a backend that supports disabling reasoning, the request must ask the backend not to emit thinking/reasoning output.
locked_rules.R026: init.cs runs only on first boot, never on later normal boots.
locked_rules.R027: system/library and extensions content merge into canonical symbol trees; they are not mixed into per-instance runtime state.
locked_rules.R028: Writable/persona-capable layout modules require explicit id.
locked_rules.R029: Duplicate writable module ids inside the same layout instance are invalid and must error clearly.
locked_rules.R030: Role reload updates canonical role source only. Next execution uses updated role data automatically.

forbidden: Materialized one-time role snapshots as the default model
UI-only fields inside backend payload builder logic

role_model.definition: Roles are reusable config overlays plus optional prompt material. They are canonical data sources, not instance snapshots.

required_behavior.selection_storage: |<instance>:<module_id>:role stores only the selected role reference string
required_behavior.resolution_time: Role data is resolved from #ROLES at execution time
required_behavior.reload_behavior: reload role / reload roles updates canonical #ROLES data; no per-instance copy refresh is required

base_alias_profile_model.definition: Alias/profile provides normal backend connection and default model config.
base_alias_profile_model.note: Base profile may also include backend default values for think/stream/sampler fields, but role and instance override them.

instance_override_model.definition: Instance overrides are the final overlay layer and only affect that specific q module instance.

effective_config_construction.definition: The effective config is built once per q execution from the active q root and canonical role data.
algorithm: Step 1: Determine the active q module root exactly, e.g. |HELP:q.
Step 2: Read selected role reference from |HELP:q:role if present.
Step 3: Build base config from selected alias/profile and command context.
Step 4: Resolve role data from #ROLES using the role reference.
Step 5: Overlay backend-relevant role fields onto the base config.
Step 6: Overlay instance override fields from |HELP:q:* onto the role-augmented config.
Step 7: Inject role optional system prompt into the message/prompt structure in the backend-specific way.
Step 8: Freeze the resulting effective config for this execution.
Step 9: Build the backend payload only from this frozen effective config.
effective_config_construction.absolute_rule: No later payload-building step may re-resolve think/stream/sampler values from unrelated state roots.

payload_model.definition: Payload is the final backend request object produced from the frozen effective config.
must_include_when_present: stop if supported and provided by alias/profile

mapping_rules.temperature: payload.options.temperature if implementation uses options block

ollama_chat.critical_rule: If effective think is false, payload must carry think=false for Ollama-compatible backends that support it.

mapping_rules.think: Map effective think low|medium|high to backend-native reasoning effort field

gpt_oss_openai_style.critical_rule: Do not force GPT-OSS think into boolean. Boolean true/false is ignored or meaningless there.

think_semantics.definition: think is the backend reasoning control parameter.
forbidden_design: Treating show_thinking as the same thing as think

stream_semantics.definition: stream controls transport/response streaming behavior for the backend request.
stream_semantics.flow_rule: If stream exists in role or instance override, it must participate in effective config construction and reach payload.

show_thinking_semantics.definition: show_thinking controls only whether visible thinking is rendered in the UI.
show_thinking_semantics.absolute_rule: show_thinking must never alter the backend payload.

expected_effects.true: Visible thinking may be shown live until response starts.
expected_effects.false: Thinking is hidden from UI completely, but normal response still streams or renders as configured.

pipeline: Parser determines whether input is command/symbol assignment/plain text.
For q-routed plain text, router determines active q module root exactly.
prepare_q_session(active_q_root) resolves alias/profile + role + instance overrides.
Payload is built from frozen effective config.
Live UI state updates response/thinking display areas as needed.
Final response content is appended to :ch.
Live temp fields are cleared or normalized when the run ends.

q_runtime_root_resolution.definition: All q param lookup must resolve from the active q root directly.
incorrect_examples: fallback shadow root unrelated to active q module
q_runtime_root_resolution.critical_rule: If the active q root is |HELP:q, then think/stream/role/samplers must be read from |HELP:q:* first.

if_show_thinking_true: Before response begins, visible thinking may be shown from backend thinking channel if one exists.
When visible response begins, response replaces visible thinking in the live display area.
if_show_thinking_false: Thinking is never rendered in the UI.
if_think_disabled_in_backend: Backend request should ask for no reasoning output when that backend supports disabling it.
If a backend still violates that contract, thinking must not be appended into :ch.

role_reload_model.reload_role: Reload only the targeted canonical role package into #ROLES.
role_reload_model.reload_roles: Rebuild canonical role tree into #ROLES from source directories.
role_reload_model.post_reload_effect: The next q execution uses the updated canonical role automatically.
role_reload_model.not_required: No mandatory per-instance role-copy rebuild step.

roles.layout: System content remains clearly separated under its namespace.

layout_module_ids: Writable modules must have explicit id.
q modules are writable/persona-capable and require explicit id.
Duplicate ids inside the same layout instance must error.
Validation error must identify the offending template.
role_fields: Unknown role fields should not silently alter payload unless intentionally supported.
Known backend fields must be typed/normalized before payload build.
System prompt file is optional and must be handled if present.
think_values: For Ollama-like backends, think should normalize to boolean.
For GPT-OSS-like backends, think should normalize to low|medium|high.
Do not coerce GPT-OSS reasoning effort to boolean.

must_exist: One function that resolves active q root exactly
One function that reads role reference from active q root
One function that loads canonical role data from #ROLES
One function that reads instance overrides from active q root
One function that merges base + role + instance into a frozen effective config
One backend mapping layer that converts frozen effective config into provider-native payload
must_not_exist: Second-pass payload builder that re-reads think/stream from unrelated state roots
Implicit role materialization into instance runtime as the primary model
Mixing UI flags into backend effective config resolution

T001.name: Role fields reach payload
expect: Effective config contains think=false, stream=true, temperature=0.2 unless overridden by instance

T003.name: show_thinking does not affect payload
expect: Payload is controlled by think=false, not by show_thinking

T005.name: GPT-OSS think effort mapping
expect: Payload uses backend-native reasoning effort low

T006.name: Thinking never enters ch
given: Backend emits visible thinking and visible response
expect: Live UI may show thinking before response

T007.name: Active q root is exact
given: Current layout instance is |HELP with q module id q
expect: All q override reads resolve from |HELP:q:*

T008.name: No role copy required
given: Role canonical source is changed via reload role
expect: Next q execution uses updated canonical role data without rebuilding instance copy

common_failure_modes_to_prevent: Payload builder re-resolves think from wrong root after effective config is already built
Role data is copied into instance runtime and goes stale
show_thinking accidentally disables backend reasoning instead of just hiding UI
Instance override path reads from |Q instead of |Q:q
GPT-OSS think values are forced into boolean
Role prompt injection is skipped even though role exists
stream from role is ignored during payload construction

migration_notes.M001: Rename any active q runtime field named thinking to think.
migration_notes.M002: Keep show_thinking only at instance/layout UI level.
migration_notes.M003: Remove any logic that requires STORAGE_PREFIX for q module storage.
migration_notes.M004: Remove any assumption that roles are one-time loaded instance copies.
migration_notes.M005: Ensure prepare_q_session or equivalent freezes effective config once per execution.
migration_notes.M006: Ensure payload builders consume only frozen effective config, not ad hoc state lookups.

minimum_done_definition.D001: Active q root resolution is exact and direct.
minimum_done_definition.D002: All supported role backend fields reach payload.
minimum_done_definition.D003: Instance overrides correctly override role fields.
minimum_done_definition.D007: Role reload updates canonical data and next execution uses it.

one_sentence_summary: Build one frozen effective q config per execution from base profile + canonical role + instance overrides at the active q root, map it to backend-native payload fields, keep UI flags out of payload logic, and never materialize roles as stale per-instance copies.
